fields.label: Description
fields.value:
Māori Language Week bookmark, produced by the New Zealand Labour Party. Showing images of the Labour Māori caucus. (200-?) (bookmark)

'O Nga Kura Tuarua O Aotearoa 2000' - Inaugural National Secondary Schools Kapa Haka Competitions. Held at Aotea Centre, Auckland. June 23 - 24, 2000 (programme)

'Te Pou Taki Korero Illustrators Award'. Entry form, cover letter and promotional poster. July - August, 2001 (A3 poster, entry form, letter)

'Nation Building and Māori Development in the 21st Century Conference'. Held at the School of Māori and Pacific Development, University of Waikato, Hamilton. August 30 - September 1, 2000 (programme)

'Nga Puna Waihanga National Hui'. Held at Te Aute College, Hawkes Bay. Information leaflet. December 8 - 10, 2000 (pamphlet and A3 poster)

'Mata - Māori Adornment'. Exhibition at Auckland Central City Library. August 24 - October 26, 2001 (illustrated programme)

'Nga Manu Korero' - National Secondary Schools Speech Contest. Held at Hopuhopu. September 2001 (programme booklet - 3 copies)

'Purangiaho Seeing Clearly' - casting light on the legacy of tradition in contemporary Māori art. Exhibition held at the Auckland Art Gallery. September 15 - November 25, (2001?) (A4 poster, Big Day Art programme)

'Kapa Haka 2002'. Aotearoa Traditional Māori Performing Arts Festival. Held at Bastion Point, Auckland. February 22 - 24, 2002 (information pamphlet and map, programme)

'Puukenga Māori Business Development Unit'. Part of the Unitec Institute of Technology, Auckland. Information leaflet. (2002?) (leaflet)

'Summary of the Foreshore and Seabed Framework' - produced by the Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet. December 2003 (A4, 6 pages)

'AUT Māori Expo'. Held at the Aotea Centre, Auckland. September 1, 2005 (postcard flyer - 2 copies)

'Te Arawa Kapa Haka Invitational 21s Competition'. Performed at Rotorua Girls High School Arena, Rotorua. November 26, 2005 (programme - 2 copies)

'40th Coronation Celebrations'. Ruby Jubilee of the Māori Queen. Held at Ngaruawahia, New Zealand. May 6 - 23, 2006 (programme - 2 copies)

'Talk About Terror' - A Public Forum at the University of Auckland. 'A forum to address the on-going fallout for Tuhoe and New Zealanders of the October 15 police action'. Held at the Engineering School Auditorium, 20 Symonds Street, Auckland. December 15, 2007 (A4 flyer)

'Talk About Terror' - A Public Forum as part of the 'Talk about Terror' series. Held at the Whare Wananga, Auckland Central Library. April 3, 2008 (A4 flyer)

'Surveilling the State'. A public forum as part of the 'Talk about Terror' series. Held at the Auckland Central Library. May 7, 2008 (A4 flyer)

'Visit The Orakei Marae, Home of the Ngati Whatua People'. Open to all migrants residing in Auckland City. June 22, 2008 (A4 flyer)

Korero Māori Resources. Order Form. For Māori Language Week. July 21 - 27, 2008 (A4 order form)

'Māori Language In The Home'. Sticker for Māori Language Week. July 21 - 27, 2008 (A5 sticker)

'Te Reo I Te Kainga - Māori Language In The Home'. Korero Māori, give it a go. Vol 5, 2008 (A6 booklet)

'Bastion Point Exhibition Handover - Marae Protocol, Marae Process'. Held at Orakei Marae. December 12, 2008 (booklet)

'Kapa Haka Kura Tuarua a Motu 2008'. National Secondary Schools Maori Performing Arts Competition. Performed at the TSB Bank Arena, Whanganui. June 17 - 19, 2008 (27 page programme)

'Ngapuhi Festival - ki Tamaki Makaurau'. Held at the Trusts Stadium, Henderson, Waitakere City. March 7, 2009 (A4 poster)
